description: VAT (DPH) per filing period, newest first: output VAT, input VAT, amount to pay or excess deduction, due date. The filing period (monthly / quarterly) comes from the company settings. Closed periods use UOL's "DPH" closing document (exact). Open periods are estimated from issued invoices — output VAT by DUZP, input VAT by the later of DUZP and the receipt date: proformas skipped, corrective invoices counted as credit notes, internal documents and reverse charge not included.

periods.description: Number of periods; default 4 for monthly payers, 2 for quarterly

name: get_vat_overview

days_left.description: Negative once the due date has passed

due_date.description: Return and payment due (25th of the following month)

period.description: YYYY-MM for monthly payers, YYYY-Qn for quarterly

preliminary.description: True for an estimate from invoices; the period has no closing document yet

to_pay.description: Positive = to pay, negative = excess deduction (nadměrný odpočet)

title: VAT by filing period
